description: Rewrite text in a different tone while keeping every fact.

tests.prompt:
Rewrite this message so it is polite and professional, keeping all the facts. Output only the rewritten message.

'Your team messed up AGAIN. The report is 3 days late and the numbers are wrong. Fix it by Friday or I am going to your boss.'
tests.rubric: Professional, courteous tone with no insults or threats. Keeps facts: report is 3 days late, numbers are incorrect, deadline Friday. May mention escalation politely but must not sound threatening.
tests.reference: Hello, the report is now three days overdue and the figures need to be corrected. Could your team please send a corrected version by Friday? Thank you for your help.

tests.prompt:
Make this friendly and casual, as a text message of at most 25 words. Output only the message.

'We regret to inform you that the event has been postponed until further notice.'
tests.rubric: Casual, friendly text-message tone; conveys that the event is postponed with no new date yet; at most 25 words; no corporate phrasing.
tests.reference: Hey! Bit of bad news: the event is postponed for now. We'll let you know as soon as we have a new date!
